SELECT MIN(n.name) AS voicing_actress, MIN(t.title) AS kung_fu_panda
FROM (
    SELECT t.id, t.title
    FROM title t
    WHERE t.production_year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2008
      AND t.title LIKE '%Kung%Fu%Panda%'
) AS t
JOIN (
    SELECT mc.movie_id, mc.company_id
    FROM movie_companies mc
    WHERE mc.note LIKE '%(200%)%'
      AND (mc.note LIKE '%(USA)%' OR mc.note LIKE '%(worldwide)%')
) AS mc ON mc.movie_id = t.id
JOIN (
    SELECT mi.movie_id
    FROM movie_info mi
    JOIN info_type it ON it.id = mi.info_type_id
    WHERE it.info = 'release dates'
      AND mi.info IS NOT NULL
      AND (mi.info LIKE 'Japan:%2007%' OR mi.info LIKE 'USA:%2008%')
) AS mi ON mi.movie_id = t.id AND mi.movie_id = mc.movie_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ci.movie_id, ci.person_id, ci.person_role_id
    FROM cast_info ci
    JOIN role_type rt ON rt.id = ci.role_id
    WHERE ci.note = '(voice)'
      AND rt.role = 'actress'
) AS ci ON ci.movie_id = t.id AND ci.movie_id = mc.movie_id AND ci.movie_id = mi.movie_id
JOIN (
    SELECT n.id, n.name
    FROM name n
    WHERE n.gender = 'f'
      AND n.name LIKE '%Angel%'
) AS n ON n.id = ci.person_id
JOIN (
    SELECT cn.id
    FROM company_name cn
    WHERE cn.country_code = '[us]'
) AS cn ON cn.id = mc.company_id
JOIN aka_name AS an ON an.person_id = ci.person_id AND n.id = an.person_id
JOIN char_name AS chn ON chn.id = ci.person_role_id
